notes.title: Cross play with Xbox Update
notes.content: [p][/p][h2]🍄 Shroom Siege Demo Now Cross-Play with Xbox! ⚔️[/h2][p]Big news, mushroom warriors! 🌟[/p][p]The [b]Shroom Siege demo is now live on Xbox[/b] as part of the Xbox Indie Selects Demo Fest 2025 — and starting today, we’ve added [b]full cross-play support with Steam[/b]![/p][p]That means whether you’re defending shrines or pushing poop with your trusty beetle, you can now [b]team up with friends across Xbox and Steam[/b] in chaotic 4v4 online battles.[/p][h3]🆕 What’s New:[/h3][list][*][p]🔗 [b]Cross-Play Multiplayer[/b] – Steam + Xbox players, united in battle[/p][/*][*][p]⚔️ [b]Bigger Community[/b] – More warriors, more action, more mushroom mayhem[/p][/*][*][p]🗺️ [b]Two New Maps Added to the Demo![/b] – Fresh battlegrounds to explore and conquer[/p][/*][/list][p]This is just the beginning—your feedback during the demo will help us fine-tune balance and prepare for the full release in 2025.[/p][p]👉 Play the Demo on Steam[/p][p]🍄⚔️ Siege together, anywhere![/p][h3]🍄 [b]NEW MAPS!!!! 🐝🐝🐝🐝[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43980941/f3c19069ce9d3a89215c39473a2ad580400070d4.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]🍄 🌸🌺🌼🌻🌷🌹🍄🍄🍄🍄[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43980941/68d2436b485c8d444826a9dbb865a3b655bcfc9f.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Let's Play with Shroom Siege Devs
notes.content:
Join us for a special live stream event where you'll have the opportunity to interact directly with the creative minds behind Shroom Siege! This event is your chance to dive deeper into the world of Shroom Siege, ask burning questions, and get a sneak peek at what's coming next.


[h2]What to Expect?[/h2]

Live Gameplay with Developers
Watch as the developers themselves step into the vibrant world of Shroom Siege! You'll see them strategize, coordinate, and go head-to-head in an exciting 4v4 showdown. As they play, they'll share insights into the game's mechanics, strategies, and the inspiration behind it all.


[h2]Interactive Q&A Session[/h2]

Have questions about the game design, strategies, or future plans? This is your chance to ask! Our developers will be answering your questions live. Whether you're curious about the inspiration behind the game, have questions about advanced strategies, or want to know more about upcoming features, this is your chance to ask directly. We will be monitoring our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Ee6k2sYg]Discord server[/url] for messages 


[h2]Sneak Peeks and Surprises[/h2]

We have a few surprises up our sleeves! You'll be among the first to hear about upcoming updates, new features, and future plans for Shroom Siege. Don't miss this chance to get an exclusive look at what's coming next.


[h2]Who Should Attend?[/h2]

Whether you're a seasoned player looking for advanced tips and strategies, a newcomer wanting to learn more about the game, or simply a fan of Shroom Siege, this event is for you!

Join us for this unique opportunity to connect with the developers, learn more about the game, and get a glimpse of the future of Shroom Siege. We can't wait to see you there!
